info.title: Synthetics Bulk Action API
info.description:
# Overview
The Synthetics Bulk Action API applies changes to many synthetic tests in one request. Bulk actions run asynchronously: each request returns a workflow ID that can be polled for status.

### Key Features
* Update attributes of multiple synthetic tests at once
* Add or remove values on set-valued attributes instead of replacing them
* Track per-test outcome of a bulk update

### Protocols
Each method can be called through any of these protocols:
* REST: the HTTP paths documented below
* gRPC and gRPC-Web
* [Connect](https://connectrpc.com/docs/protocol): unary HTTP POST to `/kentik.synthetics.v20261005alpha1.SyntheticsBulkActionService/<Method>` with an `application/json` or `application/proto` body

post.description:
Applies the same attribute changes to up to 50 synthetic tests. Only some attributes can be bulk-updated, and some can be changed only on certain test types or only together with another attribute. Tests are validated first; by default, if any test fails validation no test is updated (see `allow_partial_batch`). Tests that pass are then updated asynchronously: the reply carries the initial status and, if anything was started, a `workflow_id` to pass to GetBulkUpdateTestsStatus. Fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT (HTTP 400) if the request is malformed, such as no IDs, more than 50 IDs, no attributes to update, an attribute that cannot be bulk-updated, or an attribute that does not apply to every selected test's type; RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (HTTP 429) if the company lacks the synthetics credits for the change; and UNKNOWN (HTTP 500) if the update could not be confirmed as started. After UNKNOWN the update may still run, so check the tests before retrying.

### Bulk-updatable attributes
Paths are relative to `test` and shown in JSON (camelCase) form. snake_case is also accepted, and error messages report paths in snake_case.

| Path | Notes |
|------|-------|
| `name` | |
| `status` | `TEST_STATUS_ACTIVE` or `TEST_STATUS_PAUSED` |
| `settings.period` | |
| `settings.agentIds` | supports ADD and REMOVE |
| `settings.healthSettings.activation.times` | |
| `settings.healthSettings.activation.timeWindow` | |
| `settings.healthSettings.activation.gracePeriod` | |
| `settings.healthSettings.latencyCritical`, `latencyWarning` | set together |
| `settings.healthSettings.latencyCriticalStddev`, `latencyWarningStddev` | set together; also sets `latencyCritical` and `latencyWarning` to 0 |
| `settings.healthSettings.jitterCritical`, `jitterWarning` | set together |
| `settings.healthSettings.jitterCriticalStddev`, `jitterWarningStddev` | set together; also sets `jitterCritical` and `jitterWarning` to 0 |
| `settings.healthSettings.packetLossCritical`, `packetLossWarning` | set together |
| `settings.ip.targets` | supports ADD and REMOVE |
| `settings.networkGrid.targets` | supports ADD and REMOVE |
| `settings.dns.servers` | supports ADD and REMOVE |
| `settings.dns.target` | |
| `settings.dnsGrid.servers` | supports ADD and REMOVE |
| `settings.dnsGrid.target` | |
| `settings.hostname.target` | |
| `settings.url.target` | |
| `settings.pageLoad.target` | |
| `settings.agent.target` | |

A threshold pair and its Stddev pair cannot be set in the same request.

### Examples
Change the period of several tests:
```json
{"ids": ["101", "102"], "test": {"settings": {"period": 300}}}
```
Add an agent to each test, keeping the agents already assigned. In JSON, a field mask is a single comma-separated string:
```json
{"ids": ["101", "102"], "test": {"settings": {"agentIds": ["55"]}},
 "ops": [{"mask": "settings.agentIds", "op": "BULK_FIELD_OP_ADD"}]}
```
Set attributes to zero. A zero value cannot be told apart from an unset one, so `mask` must name it:
```json
{"ids": ["101"], "test": {"settings": {"healthSettings": {"jitterCritical": 0, "jitterWarning": 0}}},
 "mask": "settings.healthSettings.jitterCritical,settings.healthSettings.jitterWarning"}
```

get.summary: Get status of a bulk test update
get.description: Returns the current state and per-test outcome of a bulk update started by BulkUpdateTests. When `end_time` is set, the bulk update has finished and its status will not change. Items skipped before the update started are reported only in the BulkUpdateTests reply. Status is kept for a limited time after a bulk update finishes, so read it soon after `end_time` is set. Fails with NOT_FOUND (HTTP 404) if the workflow ID is unknown, the bulk update was started by a different user, or its status is no longer kept.

parameters.name: workflowId
parameters.description: Bulk update to report on, as returned in `status.workflow_id` by BulkUpdateTests.

gracePeriod.description: Period of healthy status in minutes within the time window not cancelling alarm activation

timeUnit.description: Time unit for specifying time window (m | h)

timeWindow.description: Time window for evaluating of test for alarm activation

times.description: Number of occurrences of unhealthy test status within the time window triggering alarm activation

useLocalIp.description: Boolean value indicating whether to use local (private) IP address of the target agent

reciprocal.description: Boolean value indicating whether to make the test bidirectional

disableWarningNotifications.description: Boolean indicating whether to disable warning-level alert notifications

v202309AlertingType.description:
- ALERTING_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Invalid value.
 - ALERTING_TYPE_AGENT: Per-Agent - Generates alerts based on individual metric thresholds (This can be noisy)
 - ALERTING_TYPE_GROUPED: Grouped - Reduces the number of alert notifications for upstream issues by forcing alert conditions to exist across multiple network paths
 - ALERTING_TYPE_SUBTEST: All metrics - Calculates health and alerts for the test as a whole
v202309AlertingType.title: AlertingType

v202309DNSRecord.description:
- DNS_RECORD_UNSPECIFIED: Invalid value
 - DNS_RECORD_A: name to IPv4 address(es) mapping
 - DNS_RECORD_AAAA: name to IPv6 address(es) mapping
 - DNS_RECORD_CNAME: alternative resource name
 - DNS_RECORD_DNAME: alternative resource set name
 - DNS_RECORD_NS: domain to name server mapping
 - DNS_RECORD_MX: SMTP mail server record
 - DNS_RECORD_PTR: IPv4/6 address to name mapping
 - DNS_RECORD_SOA: domain meta-data
v202309DNSRecord.title: DNSRecord

v20261005alpha1BulkActionItemState.description:
- BULK_ACTION_ITEM_STATE_PENDING: Accepted and waiting to be processed.
 - BULK_ACTION_ITEM_STATE_PROCESSING: Being processed.
 - BULK_ACTION_ITEM_STATE_SUCCEEDED: Processed successfully.
 - BULK_ACTION_ITEM_STATE_FAILED: Not processed, or processing failed. See `error`.
v20261005alpha1BulkActionItemState.title: BulkActionItemState

id.description: ID of the item, such as a test ID.

error.description: Why the item failed or was not processed. Empty unless `state` is FAILED.

errorType.description: Category of the error, when the item failed during processing. Empty for items rejected by request validation.

field.description: The field that failed validation, when the item was rejected by request validation. Empty for items that failed during processing.

v20261005alpha1BulkActionState.description:
- BULK_ACTION_STATE_SUBMITTED: Accepted and started. Reported only in the reply to the request that started the bulk action.
 - BULK_ACTION_STATE_RUNNING: In progress.
 - BULK_ACTION_STATE_PAUSED: Paused before it finished.
 - BULK_ACTION_STATE_COMPLETED: Finished. Individual items may still have failed; see `failed_count` and `items`.
 - BULK_ACTION_STATE_FAILED: Stopped because of an error that affects the whole bulk action, not just one item.
 - BULK_ACTION_STATE_CANCELLED: Cancelled before it finished.
 - BULK_ACTION_STATE_TERMINATED: Forcibly stopped before it finished.
 - BULK_ACTION_STATE_TIMED_OUT: Did not finish within the allowed time.
v20261005alpha1BulkActionState.title: BulkActionState

workflowId.description: ID to use when requesting the status of the bulk action. Empty when nothing was started, for example because every item was rejected; there is then nothing to poll.

startTime.description: When the bulk action started running (UTC). Not included in the reply to the request that started it.

endTime.description: When the bulk action finished (UTC). Set only after it has finished, so its presence means no further changes will occur.

totalCount.description: Number of distinct items in the request. Counts and `items` may be omitted after the bulk action has finished and per-item results are no longer available; an omitted count means unknown, while 0 means none.

failedCount.description: Number of items that failed validation or processing.

pendingCount.description: Number of items not yet processed.

items.description: Items that failed, with the reason for each. Items that succeeded or are still pending are not listed. An item may appear more than once if several of its fields failed validation.

skippedCount.description: Number of items in `skipped`. Reported only in the reply to the request that started the bulk action.

skipped.description: Items that were not processed, with the reason for each: for example, IDs that do not exist or that no requested change applies to, or valid items held back because the request was rejected. Reported only in the reply to the request that started the bulk action.

v20261005alpha1BulkActionStatus.description: absent when nothing was dispatched, so no workflow exists to poll
v20261005alpha1BulkActionStatus.title: BulkActionStatus

v20261005alpha1BulkFieldOp.description:
- BULK_FIELD_OP_REPLACE: Replace the existing value. This is the default for attributes that are not listed in `ops`.
 - BULK_FIELD_OP_ADD: Add the given values to the existing list.
 - BULK_FIELD_OP_REMOVE: Remove the given values from the existing list.
v20261005alpha1BulkFieldOp.title: BulkFieldOp

mask.description: Set-valued attributes, relative to `test`, that this op applies to. Each must also be in the request's effective `mask`.

ids.description: IDs of the tests to update, as decimal integers. Between 1 and 50 distinct IDs; duplicates are ignored. Deleted tests and IDs that do not exist are reported in `skipped`.

mask.description: Attributes to be updated, relative to `test`. When empty, the populated attributes of `test` are updated; nothing else is replaced. Required only to set an attribute to its zero or empty value. Wildcard and non-leaf paths are rejected.

ops.description: Add or remove values on set-valued attributes instead of replacing them. Attributes not listed are replaced. A path may appear in at most one rule; duplicates are rejected.

allowPartialBatch.description: When true, tests that pass validation are updated even if others fail it. When false (the default), no test is updated if any test fails validation. Does not apply to attributes limited to certain test types: if any selected test is of another type, the whole request is rejected either way.
